channel.title: What makes the Foundation the Foundation?
channel.description: Posts in the discussion thread "What makes the Foundation the Foundation?" - A very dumb question I know.

item.title: Re: What makes the Foundation the Foundation?
item.content:encoded:
I feel like there's kind of 2 questions here.

In regards to leadership, there is a hierarchy, it's just not interesting enough to mention in many stories. Think about the O5's (and the Ethics Committee, who have similar power) like the board of a corporation or president of a state, and fill in all the boring jobs beneath them. Site Directors are the next down in power, and there are many stories on the wiki that involve the end of the world that show Sites still independently functioning.

For the essence, I agree with Nagiros that research is a core practice. The Foundation believes in the status quo, and the status quo objective way to understand the world is science. Beyond that, if you learn to understand an anomaly, then it is no longer anomalous (even if you don't plan to let the world know.) I picture the Foundation as being very academic, with scientists working on many different SCPs collaborating and publishing and sharing knowledge. See Kate Mctiriss's articles for a little taste of this.

If you want the super broad answer, the core essence is Secure, Contain, Protect. Secure and Contain refer to anomalies, while Protect refers to anomalies (from outside forces), humanity (from anomalies), and normalcy (from even knowledge of anomalies).

item.title: Re: What makes the Foundation the Foundation?
item.content:encoded:
So what makes the foundation once you strip away the O5 council and the researchers?

In addition to the Council and Research/Development, the Foundation also has a lot of administrative and military infrastructure. The Council is generally understand as kinds of "eyes in the sky", but in their absence each site would exercise regional oversight and probably have the manpower to maintain the status quo. Big picture stuff, like making some world-saving weapon or another, requires some level of comprehensive knowledge of the anomalous and research/development.

If you were to ask me "What is the Foundation's essense?" I'd probably respond that it's their particular dogma. Research and containment, essentially. The Council, researchers, and nearly everything else is built on maintaining a status quo.

item.title: What makes the Foundation the Foundation?
item.content:encoded: What is the main core of the Foundation? sure we have the O5 council but they can't run the entire foundation with all these new anomalies all around the world by themselves(probably). The researchers don't run the foundation since they only know what's in their current clearance level. So what makes the foundation once you strip away the O5 council and the researchers? Chaos all around the world? or would the essence of the foundation keep the anomalies at bay?
